subject.title: Feature: generate readable names for managed worktrees

question: Should OpenClaw adopt readable inferred names as the default identity for managed worktrees, including session-derived names and cross-process same-owner reuse?
rationale: This changes a user-visible default and may alter branch/path and session-recovery expectations; the issue proposes several naming sources and allocation policies without verified current-main ownership or upgrade evidence.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded allocator
options.body: Approve a single canonical inferred-name allocator after its current worktree, session, collision, and persistence contracts are mapped.

options.title: Keep opaque defaults
options.body: Retain the current random-name behavior and require clients that need semantic names to continue supplying explicit names.

options.title: Narrow to presentation only
options.body: Use readable labels in session and dashboard views while leaving generated branch and checkout identifiers unchanged.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded allocator
recommendation.body: Approve a single canonical inferred-name allocator after its current worktree, session, collision, and persistence contracts are mapped.
